messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doctors usually start older adults on a low dose"
set: ["doctors usually start older adults on a low dose", "older adults and people with heart disease usually started on lower dose", "start with a low dose and gradually increase dose", "doctor may start on low dose and raise it gradually", "lower dose may be needed for older adults", "older adults may take less frequently than younger adults", "doctor will start on suitable dose and adjust gradually based on blood tests", "start at low end of dosing range", "treatment usually started at lower dose", "start at 5 mg for adults 65 and older and people with mild liver problems", "start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly", "start with 25 mg a day", "low starting dose is generally used", "kidney problems do not usually change your dose", "may start to feel relief on first day", "usually taken once a day in the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "older adults and people with heart disease usually started on lower dose",
    "lower dose may be needed for older adults",
    "older adults may take less frequently than younger adults",
    "start at low end of dosing range",
    "treatment usually started at lower dose",
    "start at 5 mg for adults 65 and older and people with mild liver problems",
    "start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly"
  ],
  "alias": "start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly"
}
